facts.summary: Phase 3 met primary endpoint but modest -3.6 MADRS gap · Phase 3 · COMP360 psilocybin in treatment-resistant depression · not yet approved

evidence.summary: announced today the successful achievement of the primary endpoint in the ongoing Phase 3 COMP005 trial, the first of two Phase 3 trials evaluating COMP360, a synthetic, proprietary formulation of psilocybin, for treatment-resistant depression (TRD).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: announced today the successful achievement of the primary endpoint in the ongoing Phase 3 COMP005 trial
evidence.safety: safety findings are consistent with previous studies of COMP360 and there are no new or unexpected safety findings.
